items.summaryEn: First game of new Premier League season, 8pm kick-offArsenal’s opportunity | Football Daily | Mail ScottPlenty of debutants in the cast tonight. Every single one of them will have been dreaming of something like this …Mikel Arteta’s turn to talk pitchside to Sky. “The players need that desire to go again … I certainly have it … we have to create an opportunity … we don’t know what other clubs are going to do … we have to be the best version of ourselves … we have to deliver our game for 96 minutes every three days … if you are not capable of doing that, you are in trouble … we have to get better … we are trying to improve the team [in the transfer window] … but so far I am very happy.” Continue reading...
bodyEn: Pre-season postbag: moaning about the state of modern television and pop music (which kind of gives away our demographic but what are you gonna do?) edition. “Almost as good as the music from those Granada Football titles is the variety in the clips. There’s fouls, bad control, close misses, mud, as well as a couple of goals. The people who put that together clearly had a much better understanding of the game than those who think all we’re interested in is seeing the ball hitting the net” – David Wall

“I saw a very early Kasabian at Brixton Academy, sandwiched between the Cooper Temple Clause and Black Rebel Motorcycle Club. Both of whom were much more entertaining. They were toilet then, and they’re toilet now. But in fairness, they have since been tremendously successful, if a little one-dimensional. Entirely unrelated, Arsenal surely can’t do it again. I’m predicting a battling third-place finish for them” – Matt Dony

Pre-season postbag: football edition. “Arsenal and Coventry means only one thing to me. Boxing Day 1999, Coventry 3 Arsenal 2. Robbie Keane scored the most impudent of goals. It probably doesn’t stick out for other people but my parents had finally got Sky (Christmas present) and this was one of the first matches that I watched at home and it has stayed with all these years. Strange how something so inconsequential can stay in the memory for some reason like that” – John Brennan

“How to take on this Arsenal? Well it is kind of straight forward. Look at what Arsenal does when their press is broken: they drop into a 4-4-2 (11 behind the ball) such that any ball carrier will always be running at two defenders. If Arsenal wide men (Tzolis, Madueke) get a run at single defenders, Coventry is going to get diced. If Coventry keep two on ones everywhere, the only Arsenal player that can reliably beat a double team is 16 years old. 0-0. Well done Sky Blues!” – Drew Lundgren

“It is so great to have Premier League football back so, at least for a moment, we have something to take our minds off of the hellscape we live in today. Will Coventry get blitzed? Of course, but it will be fun anyway” – Mary Waltz
“I recently wrote a few words about Coventry’s 3-0 win at Highbury in 1993. As an Arsenal fan who sat in the new North Bank that day, it wasn’t much fun” – Steve Pye
Plenty of debutants in the cast tonight. Every single one of them will have been dreaming of something like this …

Mikel Arteta’s turn to talk pitchside to Sky. “The players need that desire to go again … I certainly have it … we have to create an opportunity … we don’t know what other clubs are going to do … we have to be the best version of ourselves … we have to deliver our game for 96 minutes every three days … if you are not capable of doing that, you are in trouble … we have to get better … we are trying to improve the team [in the transfer window] … but so far I am very happy.”
He also reports that Bruno Guimarães “had a slight tension in his groin … he did not have a pre-season … we need to take him bit by bit.”

Coventry manager Frank Lampard speaks to Sky Sports. “It means a great deal … the story of 25 years … what the fans were desperate for … we’ve managed to bring that back to the club … amazing, but now reality’s here and we’re driving up to the Emirates … I love it … the top level … the team that got us here deserve it … you’re gonna play Arsenal away at some point in the season … our season will not be defined by this game … we need to keep the balance … of course we had to add to it … we’re happy with what we’ve done … hopefully that’ll show on the pitch.”

Arsenal make two changes to the side that started the 3-0 Community Shield rout of Manchester City. Bukayo Saka and Declan Rice replace Noni Madueke, who is benched, and the injured Bruno Guimarães, who is expected to be missing for a few weeks after picking up a thigh problem at Wembley. Christos Tzolis makes his Premier League debut.

Coventry City have a few debutants on their teamsheet. Swiss defender Aurèle Amenda, Ghana midfielder Caleb Yirenkyi and French winger Loum Tchaouna start, while Taiwo Awoniyi, this week’s signing from Nottingham Forest, and Gustavo Hamer, newly returned from Sheffield United, are on the bench.
Arsenal: Raya, White, Mosquera, Gabriel, Calafiori, Odegaard, Rice, Lewis-Skelly, Saka, Havertz, Tzolis.Subs: Arrizabalaga, Hincapie, Eze, Gyokeres, Madueke, Nwaneri, Merino, Zubimendi, Dowman.

Coventry City: Rushworth, van Ewijk, Thomas, Amenda, Dasilva, Onyeka, Yirenkyi, Grimes, Thomas-Asante, Simms, Tchaouna.Subs: Wilson, Rudoni, Sakamoto, Awoniyi, Kitching, Latibeaudiere, Eccles, Overgaard, Hamer.
Referee: Thomas Bramall VAR: Jarred Gillett

BREAKING NEWS: Sky Sports are still using that indefensible Kasabian racket for their Premier League theme tune. Bah. Had been very much hoping they’d replace it for the new campaign. Me, I’d pop the master tapes in the nearest brazier, and instead whack on Magic Trumpet by Herb Alpert and the Tijuana Brass, last used in this specific context by Granada Television for their gloriously Soviet-branded late-60s programme FOOTBALL. Tell me this wouldn’t improve your mood at least tenfold every time you heard it.
… and now some Cov-infused build-up. That opening-weekend fever beginning to kick in now, right?
Some even-hotter-off-the-press preview action here. Firstly of an Arsenal bent …

… so let’s start at the very beginning. One step before the beginning, in fact. The Guardian presents, for your edification, the Premier League 2026-27 previews for Arsenal and Coventry City. Just in case you missed them.

The Premier League is back, and you won’t get too many people making a case for newly promoted Coventry City to get something in tonight’s opening game against champions Arsenal. But then on the first day of the 1993-94 season, Micky Quinn did this …

… and there weren’t too many at Highbury expecting that either. Throw in that Lee Dixon own goal, the centrepiece of another early-season away win for Cov, this time in 1991-92 with Arsenal reigning champions, and the Sky Blues have some disruptive form here. On the other hand, that was over 30 years ago, and Arsenal have won all five of the meetings between these clubs in the 21st century, albeit the last of those being in 2014. So take your pick as the champions of England meet the winners of the Championship. Kick-off is at 8pm BST. It’s back, and it’s on!

items.titleZh: 阿森纳对阵考文垂城：英超联赛 – 直播
items.summaryZh: 新赛季英超首战，阿森纳主场迎战考文垂。
bodyZh: 季前赛来信：抱怨现代电视和流行音乐（这有点暴露了我们的年龄层，但你又能怎样？）版本。“那段格拉纳达足球片头曲几乎和剪辑的多样性一样精彩。有犯规、失误、错失良机、泥泞，还有几个进球。制作这段视频的人显然比那些认为我们只对球击中球网感兴趣的人更懂比赛。”——大卫·沃尔
“我在布里克斯顿学院看过非常早期的卡萨比安，夹在库珀·坦普尔条款和黑叛逆摩托车俱乐部之间。这两支乐队都比他们有趣得多。他们当时是垃圾，现在也是垃圾。但平心而论，他们后来取得了巨大的成功，虽然有点单一。完全不搭边的是，阿森纳肯定不能再夺冠了。我预测他们会拼尽全力拿到第三名。”——马特·多尼
季前赛来信：足球版。“阿森纳和考文垂对我来说只有一件事。1999年节礼日，考文垂3比2阿森纳。罗比·基恩打进了一个最无礼的进球。它可能对别人来说并不突出，但我的父母终于有了天空电视台（圣诞礼物），这是我在家看的第一批比赛之一，这么多年一直记着。奇怪的是，这样无关紧要的事情怎么会因为某种原因留在记忆中。”——约翰·布伦南
“如何对付这支阿森纳？嗯，这很简单。看看阿森纳在逼抢被破解时做什么：他们落位4-4-2（11人守在球后），这样任何持球者总会面对两名后卫。如果阿森纳的边路球员（佐利斯、马杜埃凯）获得单挑后卫的机会，考文垂就会被撕裂。如果考文垂到处都是双人防守，唯一能可靠突破双人包夹的阿森纳球员只有16岁。0比0。干得好，蓝军！”——德鲁·伦德格伦
“英超联赛回归真是太棒了，至少暂时我们有些东西可以转移对当今地狱般世界的注意力。考文垂会被碾压吗？当然，但无论如何都会很有趣。”——玛丽·沃尔兹
“我最近写了几句关于考文垂1993年在海布里3比0获胜的文章。作为那天坐在新北看台的阿森纳球迷，那可不好玩。”——史蒂夫·派
今晚的阵容中有很多首秀球员。他们每一个人都在梦想着这样的时刻……
米克尔·阿尔特塔在场边接受天空体育采访。“球员们需要再次出发的渴望……我当然有……我们必须创造机会……我们不知道其他俱乐部会做什么……我们必须成为最好的自己……我们必须每三天打出96分钟的比赛……如果你做不到，你就有麻烦……我们必须变得更好……我们正在尝试在转会窗口提升球队……但到目前为止我非常满意。”
他还报道称布鲁诺·吉马良斯“腹股沟有些紧张……他没有参加季前赛……我们需要让他循序渐进。”
考文垂主教练弗兰克·兰帕德接受天空体育采访。“这意义重大……25年的故事……球迷们渴望的……我们已经设法把它带回了俱乐部……太棒了，但现在现实来了，我们要开往酋长球场……我喜欢……顶级水平……把我们带到这里来的球队配得上这一切……你总会在赛季某个时候客场对阵阿森纳……我们的赛季不会由这场比赛定义……我们需要保持平衡……当然我们必须补充……我们对自己所做的感到满意……希望这能在球场上体现出来。”
阿森纳对上周日3比0战胜曼城的社区盾杯首发阵容做出了两处调整。布卡约·萨卡和德克兰·赖斯替换了坐在替补席上的诺尼·马杜埃凯和受伤的布鲁诺·吉马良斯，后者在温布利大腿受伤，预计将缺席数周。克里斯托斯·佐利斯上演英超首秀。
考文垂城首发名单中有多名新援。瑞士后卫奥雷勒·阿门达、加纳中场卡莱布·伊伦基和法国边锋卢姆·查乌纳首发，而本周从诺丁汉森林签下的泰沃·阿沃尼伊和刚从谢菲尔德联回归的古斯塔沃·哈默则坐在替补席上。
阿森纳：拉亚、怀特、莫斯克拉、加布里埃尔、卡拉菲奥里、厄德高、赖斯、刘易斯-斯凯利、萨卡、哈弗茨、佐利斯。替补：阿里萨巴拉加、辛卡皮、埃泽、约克雷斯、马杜埃凯、恩瓦内里、梅里诺、祖比门迪、道曼。
考文垂城：拉什沃思、范埃韦克、托马斯、阿门达、达席尔瓦、奥涅卡、伊伦基、格莱姆斯、托马斯-阿森特、西姆斯、查乌纳。替补：威尔逊、鲁多尼、坂本、阿沃尼伊、基钦、拉蒂博迪埃、埃克尔斯、奥弗加德、哈默。
裁判：托马斯·布拉莫尔 VAR：贾里德·吉莱特
突发新闻：天空体育还在用那首不可饶恕的卡萨比安曲子作为英超主题曲。唉。我曾非常希望他们新赛季换掉它。我嘛，会把母带扔进最近的火盆里，换上赫布·阿尔珀特和蒂华纳铜管乐队的《魔术小号》，这首歌最后一次被使用是在格拉纳达电视台那档光荣的苏联风格60年代末节目《足球》中。告诉我这不会让你的心情每次听到都好上十倍。
……现在一些考文垂的赛前报道。那种首轮狂热现在开始了吗？
这里有一些更热乎的预览。首先是阿森纳的……
……所以我们从头开始。实际上是从开始前一步。卫报为您呈现，为了您的教育，2026-27赛季英超联赛阿森纳和考文垂城的预览。以防您错过了。
英超联赛回来了，你不会听到太多人为新晋升的考文垂城在今晚对阵冠军阿森纳的首场比赛中拿分说好话。但在1993-94赛季的第一天，米基·奎因做到了……
……海布里也没有多少人预料到这一点。再加上李·迪克森的乌龙球，那是考文垂又一次赛季初客场获胜的核心，这次是在1991-92赛季，当时阿森纳是卫冕冠军，蓝军在这里有一些破坏性的表现。另一方面，那是30多年前了，阿森纳在21世纪赢下了两队之间的全部五次交锋，尽管最近一次是在2014年。所以当英格兰冠军对阵英冠冠军时，你选吧。开球时间是英国夏令时晚上8点。它回来了，开始了！

items.titleEn: Team news: Rice and Saka start against Coventry
items.summaryEn: Find out who Mikel Arteta has selected for this evening's Premier League opener against Coventry City
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has opted to include Declan Rice and Bukayo Saka in his starting line-up for tonight’s Premier League curtain-raiser against Coventry City.

The England pair return to our starting line-up for the first time this summer after their extended breaks after England’s run to the World Cup semi-finals, and starting Sunday’s Community Shield win over Manchester City on the bench before entering the fray as subs.
They replace Bruno Guimaraes and Noni Madueke, with the Brazilian missing out on his Premier League debut for bow after picking up an injury during the game in Cardiff on Sunday.
Christos Tzolis will though make his league bow in red and white, aiming to follow up his impressive showing five days ago when he registered two assists.
Madueke drops down to the bench, which includes two of Spain’s World Cup winners in Martin Zubimendi and Mikel Merino, with a third in David Raya lining up between our posts.
LINE-UP
Arsenal: Raya, White, Mosquera, Gabriel, Calafiori, Lewis-Skelly, Rice, Odegaard, Saka, Tzolis, Havertz.Subs: Arrizabalaga, Hincapie, Zubimendi, Merino, Eze, Nwaneri, Madueke, Dowman, Gyokeres.

items.titleEn: Examining Ezri: How will Konsa fit in?
items.summaryEn: We take a tactical deep dive into our latest Gunner, Ezri Konsa
bodyEn: “Cool, calm and collected” – Those are the words Ezri Konsa used to describe his style of defending after joining us from Aston Villa.
The defender has become a rock at the back in Birmingham, helping the Villains go from battling relegation to Europa League glory in seven years.
As he makes his move back to the capital, we examine why Ezri is a key cog in our defensive unit ahead of the 2026/27 campaign.
YOU, SHALL NOT, PASS
Ezri Konsa is a tricky man to get past. In 2025/26, he was dribbled past just four times, the second fewest of any defender playing over 30 matches.
That trend goes all the way back to his Premier League debut in 2019. In 231 Premier League appearances, he has been dribbled past by an opponent just 37 times, at a rate of 0.17 times per 90.
While his defending in one-on-ones has already been praised by Bukayo Saka, his tackle rate has also been exemplary.

OPTA has analysed Ezri’s ‘true tackle’ success rate. A 'true tackle' attempt is the sum of successful tackles (where possession is regained or when the ball goes out of play and is safe), challenges lost (where a player attempts a tackle and doesn’t connect with the ball), and fouls when attempting a tackle.
In this metric, Ezri has made 294 true tackles at a 74.8% success rate, the second highest of any defender since making his debut in August 2019, with only Ethan Pinnock of Brentford ranking higher.
On top of that, Ezri is not afraid to put his body on the line, making 29 blocks in 25/26, the ninth-highest of any Premier League player.
SETTING THE TEMPO
A Mikel Arteta team is built on keeping the ball and keeping control.
Ezri Konsa said he likes getting on the ball, and the stats show he’s one of the very best defenders with the ball at his feet.

Only three players made more successful passes in their own half than Ezri last term in the Premier League, producing 1337 in total. His 2003 successful passes were the seventh-highest total of any PL player in 25/26.
In addition, Ezri was in the top 10 for attacking line-breaking passes with 151, more than any Arsenal defender last season. This shows his ability to progress the play forward.
Our new signing has a Premier League-leading 95.5% pass completion rate in 2025/26 among those who played over 100 minutes.
Even more impressive, he also has a league-high 93.8% completion rate with passes while under pressure from an opponent.
In the past three seasons, his number of passes under high pressure is 2167, the fourth highest of any player in that time frame. This backs up his claim of being cool and calm on the ball.
KONSA COMPARED
Ezri was a consistent figure for Aston Villa in 2025/26, but how did he stack up against our backline over the campaign?
His 34 Premier League matches were the highest of any of his new teammates.
While he was below Gabriel and William Saliba in the number of duels won, his success rate of 67.1% was the highest among our defenders.
Elsewhere, Ezri’s passing accuracy was the best among our defenders as well as completing the highest number of passes.
VERSATILITY

“It's good being versatile,” Ezri Konsa said in his first interview. “I can do both jobs, right back and centre-back, but for me ultimately, wherever the manager wants to put me is, I’ll always do a job and do my best.”
Ezri is the latest in a line of our defenders to showcase their ability to play more than one position at the top level.
In the 9,046 minutes he played with Aston Villa, he played 77% of the time at centre-back, and operated the rest at right-back in a 4-2-3-1 formation.
During his time with the England national team, he’s also turned his hadn to the remaining positions across the backline, playing at left-sided centre back and left-back when duty has called.

items.titleZh: 深入解析：孔萨将如何融入阿森纳？
items.summaryZh: 战术解析新援孔萨的防守与传球能力。
bodyZh: “冷静、沉着、稳健”——这是埃兹里·孔萨在从阿斯顿维拉加盟后，用来形容自己防守风格的词语。
这位后卫在伯明翰成为了后防磐石，帮助维拉在七年内从保级挣扎走向欧联杯荣耀。
在他重返首都之际，我们探讨为什么孔萨是2026/27赛季前我们防守体系中的关键一环。
你，过不去
埃兹里·孔萨是一位难以突破的球员。在2025/26赛季，他仅被过人4次，在出场超过30场的后卫中排名第二少。
这一趋势可以追溯到他在2019年的英超首秀。在231场英超比赛中，他被对手过掉仅37次，每90分钟被过0.17次。
虽然他在一对一防守中的表现已得到布卡约·萨卡的称赞，他的抢断成功率也同样堪称典范。
OPTA分析了埃兹里的“真实抢断”成功率。“真实抢断”尝试是成功抢断（夺回球权或球出界安全）、抢断失败（尝试抢断但未触球）和抢断犯规的总和。
在这一指标中，埃兹里完成了294次真实抢断，成功率74.8%，自2019年8月首秀以来在所有后卫中排名第二，仅次于布伦特福德的伊桑·平诺克。
此外，埃兹里不惧身体对抗，在25/26赛季贡献了29次封堵，在英超所有球员中排名第九。
掌控节奏
米克尔·阿尔特塔的球队建立在控球和掌控比赛的基础上。
埃兹里·孔萨表示他喜欢拿球，数据也显示他是脚下技术最好的后卫之一。
上赛季英超中，只有三名球员在本方半场成功传球次数超过埃兹里，他总共完成了1337次。他在25/26赛季的2003次成功传球在所有英超球员中排名第七。
此外，埃兹里在进攻端突破传球次数上排名前十，达到151次，超过上赛季阿森纳任何一名后卫。这显示了他推进进攻的能力。
我们的新援在2025/26赛季英超中，出场超过100分钟的球员里，传球成功率高达95.5%，位居联赛第一。
更令人印象深刻的是，他在受到对手压迫时的传球成功率也高达93.8%，同样位列联赛第一。
在过去三个赛季中，他在高压下传球2167次，同期所有球员中排名第四。这印证了他所声称的控球冷静沉着。
孔萨对比
埃兹里在2025/26赛季是阿斯顿维拉的稳定力量，但他在整个赛季中与我们的后防线相比如何？
他的34场英超比赛是他所有新队友中最多的。
虽然他在赢下对抗次数上低于加布里埃尔和威廉·萨利巴，但他的67.1%成功率在我们后卫中是最高的。
此外，埃兹里的传球准确率在我们后卫中最高，同时完成了最多的传球次数。
多面手
“多面手很好，”埃兹里·孔萨在首次采访中说。“我能胜任两个位置，右后卫和中后卫，但最终，无论主教练把我放在哪里，我都会全力以赴，做到最好。”
埃兹里是我们后卫中最新一位展现顶级多位置能力的球员。
在阿斯顿维拉效力的9046分钟里，他77%的时间担任中后卫，其余时间在4-2-3-1阵型中出任右后卫。
在英格兰国家队期间，他也曾客串后防线的其他位置，在需要时担任左中卫和左后卫。

items.titleEn: Ezri Konsa: I want to keep winning
items.summaryEn: Ezri Konsa speaks to Arsenal for the first time since joining from Aston Villa!
bodyEn: Ezri Konsa has the taste for trophies and is hungry to keep on winning after joining Arsenal from Aston Villa.
The defender described his switch to N5 as a privilege as he signed his new long-term contract at Sobha Realty Training Centre.
“I’m super excited. It's a privilege to be here and can’t wait to get started,” he said in his first interview as a Gunner.
“I want to keep winning, I’m hungry to win and that’s what I’m here for. It's a proud moment for me and my family to play for one of the best teams in the world.”

Ezri is no stranger to a host of our Gunners, having played alongside Noni Madueke, Eberechi Eze, Declan Rice and Bukayo Saka at the World Cup, and the quartet gave him an insight into what life is like in N5.
“They said it's very enjoyable, they said I'll enjoy it. I've got a good relationship and I'm looking forward to training with them and playing with them.”
One in particular is Bukayo Saka, who praised Ezri back in 2024 for his defending while doing extra one-on-one sessions with England.
Recalling training with our number 7, Ezri said: “I think it was a couple of years ago with England, we did some one-on-one sessions, me against him, and yeah, I gave him a good test.
“I take a lot of pride in defending, I love defending so to hear that praise from him is nice.”
The England international’s love of defending means he’ll feel right at home in N5 as he joins a back line that kept 19 Premier League clean sheets on the way to title glory.
Ezri has come up against us on 14 previous occasions and had nothing but praise for what he’s seen from our defensive unit down the years.
He said: “The chemistry they have, they all want to defend for each other, the love they have for defending, they love keeping the ball out of the net which is what you have to do as a defender.
“But I just love the way they are together. What they've built over the past few years has been special.”
The defender is versatile, playing right back and centre-back for club and country, something he hopes can add another layer to our defensive unit.

He said: “I like to build up from the back and I like to have a lot of the ball. It's Mikel's style and from what I've seen from games, it's the same way the defenders here play. So hopefully I can add a little bit more.
“It's good being versatile. I can do both jobs, right-back and centre-back, but for me ultimately, wherever the manager wants to put me is, I’ll always do a job and do my best.”
Ezri spent seven seasons at Aston Villa after moving from Brentford, going from surviving on the final day in his first season to winning the Europa League in his final campaign.
Now he’s joined the champions, Ezri isn’t content with standing still and is hungry for more.
“That's what I'm here for, to win. Hungry for more. I had a taste of it last season with the Europa League and I want to go for it all.

“I’m very proud [of my time at Aston Villa]. Very grateful for what they did for me in my career, joining them as a boy and left as a man. I’m excited to get going at Arsenal and can’t wait to get started.”

items.titleZh: 埃兹里·孔萨：我想继续赢球
items.summaryZh: 孔萨加盟阿森纳后首次接受采访。
bodyZh: 埃兹里·孔萨在从阿斯顿维拉转会至阿森纳后，渴望继续赢得奖杯。
这名后卫在苏巴房地产训练中心签下新长期合同，将加盟N5形容为一种荣幸。
“我超级兴奋。能来到这里是一种荣幸，我已经等不及要开始了，”他在作为枪手的首次采访中表示。
“我想继续赢球，我渴望胜利，这就是我来到这里的原因。能为世界上最好的球队之一效力，对我及家人来说都是骄傲的时刻。”
埃兹里对我们许多枪手并不陌生，他曾与诺尼·马杜埃凯、埃贝雷奇·埃泽、德克兰·赖斯和布卡约·萨卡一起参加世界杯，这四人也让他对N5的生活有了了解。
“他们说这里非常愉快，我会喜欢上这里。我和他们关系不错，期待与他们一起训练和比赛。”
其中一位特别的是布卡约·萨卡，他在2024年曾因与英格兰队进行额外的一对一训练而赞扬埃兹里的防守。
在回忆起与我们7号球员的训练时，埃兹里说：“那应该是几年前在英格兰队，我们进行了一些一对一的训练，我对他，是的，我给了他一个很好的考验。”
“我以防守为荣，热爱防守，所以听到他的称赞是件很棒的事。”
这位英格兰国脚对防守的热爱意味着他会在N5有宾至如归的感觉，因为他加入了一条在夺冠路上取得19次英超零封的后防线。
埃兹里此前曾14次与我们对阵，他对多年来所看到的我们防守体系只有称赞。
他说：“他们的默契，他们都想为彼此防守，他们对防守的热爱，他们喜欢把球挡出球门，这是作为后卫必须做的。”
“但我就是喜欢他们在一起的方式。他们在过去几年里所建立的非常特别。”
这名后卫多才多艺，在俱乐部和国家队都踢过右后卫和中后卫，他希望这能为我们的防守体系增添一层新的内容。
他说：“我喜欢从后场组织进攻，喜欢多控球。这是米克尔（阿尔特塔）的风格，从我看过的比赛来看，这里的后卫也是这么踢的。所以希望我能再加入一些东西。”
“多面手是好事。我可以胜任两个位置，右后卫和中后卫，但对我来说，无论教练把我放在哪里，我都会尽我所能完成任务。”
埃兹里在从布伦特福德转会到阿斯顿维拉后，在那里度过了七个赛季，从第一个赛季最后一轮惊险保级，到最后一个赛季赢得欧联杯。
现在他加盟了冠军球队，埃兹里并不满足于现状，他渴望更多。
“这就是我来到这里的目的，去赢球。渴望更多。上赛季我在欧联杯中尝到了滋味，我想要全力以赴。”
“我为在阿斯顿维拉的时光感到非常自豪。非常感谢他们在我职业生涯中为我做的一切，我是以男孩身份加入，以男人身份离开。我很兴奋能加盟阿森纳，已经等不及要开始了。”

items.titleEn: Ezri Konsa signs for Arsenal
items.summaryEn: The England international has swapped Villa Park for Emirates Stadium on a long-term deal
bodyEn: We are delighted to announce that England international Ezri Konsa has joined us from Aston Villa on a long-term contract.

The 28-year-old began his professional career with Charlton Athletic, making his senior debut in 2016 and quickly establishing himself as one of the club’s most promising young defenders. After two seasons in the first team at The Valley, Ezri joined Brentford in 2018, where his performances during the 2018/19 season further enhanced his reputation and earned him a move to the Premier League with Aston Villa in 2019.

Ezri has spent the past seven seasons at Aston Villa, making over 200 Premier League appearances for the club across all competitions. During his time at Villa Park, his consistent performances have established him as one of the Premier League’s leading defenders, capable of operating both centrally and at right-back.

At international level, Ezri represented England’s Under-20s and Under-21s, before making his full national team debut in 2023. He has since become an established member of the England squad, representing his country at the UEFA Euro 2024 and 2026 FIFA World Cup.
Sporting Director, Andrea Berta said: “We’re delighted to have completed the signing of Ezri Konsa.

“Ezri is a defender of high quality, whose athleticism, composure and tactical intelligence have established him as one of the Premier League’s most consistent performers. Being comfortable in both central defence and at right-back, Ezri will bring valuable versatility to our squad while maintaining the high defensive standards which are fundamental to our challenge of winning major trophies.

“We are welcoming a player with proven Premier League and international experience, and strong leadership qualities, who will adapt seamlessly to our style of play. Just as importantly, we are welcoming a player with the character and mentality to make an immediate impact within our club.
“We welcome Ezri and his family to Arsenal.”
Ezri will wear the number 15 shirt and will join up with his new teammates immediately.
Everyone at Arsenal warmly welcomes Ezri and his family to the club.
The transfer is subject to the completion of regulatory processes.

items.titleEn: Odegaard on a magical summer, and new season excitement
items.summaryEn: Martin Odegaard has used his first captain's notes of the season to discuss his title-clinching emotions, the World Cup, his Community Shield display and how the new boys are looking
bodyEn: Throughout the season, Martin Odegaard will lift the lid on life in our changing room by penning his captain's column in the official Arsenal matchday programme.

Here, to celebrate the start of the new Premier League campaign, we have reproduced his notes in full ahead of the visit of Coventry City, as the skipper discusses his title-clinching emotions, the World Cup, a man-of-the-match display in the Community Shield, and how the new boys are looking:
Let me start by saying how magical the end of last season was, and a huge thank you to every single Arsenal supporter

It was just unbelievable to lift the trophy at Selhurst Park, a feeling that’s difficult to describe. It’s surreal when something you have been working so hard towards for so long finally happens. I’d been basically dreaming about that moment my whole life, so when it happens it’s all a bit crazy. It's difficult to understand and describe in the moment, but it was amazing.

It’s all so clear in my mind, being together at the training ground when we won the league, lifting the trophy, and then the parade afterwards. Seeing so many of you there was incredible. It’s a special, special memory for all of us that will be with us forever. It showed what a big club we are. Thank you from our hearts.

After that I went straight to the World Cup, and that was really good as well. We had a great tournament as a country, better than anyone expected really. The whole country was on fire supporting us – we’ve never seen anything like it in Norway. The scenes during the games, and to see all those people coming together to really enjoy it, was special. The way we were able to perform as well made it even better.

The highlight for me was definitely the Brazil game. Growing up we’d heard so much about the 1998 World Cup when Norway beat Brazil, it’s probably been the highlight of Norwegian football since I was born. So to have the chance to beat them ourselves was just so good! Congratulations to David, Mikel and Zubi for winning the tournament. It’s such a huge achievement for them, and we’re so proud as teammates of all three of them.

After the World Cup I had the chance to have a good break. I basically just stayed in Norway for the rest of the summer, spending time with my family and friends there. The weather was great, and it was really nice to be back home for a bit, spend time there and get ready for the new season.

So I’m feeling really good and the Community Shield was the perfect way to come back to competitive football. Winning a trophy is the best way to return, and we played really well too, it was a great performance from everyone.

I was pleased with my goal too, after a great move from the team. Christos had the ball on the edge and I was just waiting to see if I could get it or not. I managed to get to it first and after that it was just instinct. I didn’t really think much about it, I just did it all in the moment. Then when the keeper went down it was easy to put the ball in. Maybe you don’t see those types of goals often, so I enjoyed it, it was a nice one. I could hear Kai behind me celebrating already before I’d scored so that made me laugh!

I thought it was a strong performance all round, especially with some of our new players in there as well. Illan, Christos and Bruno have all settled really well. Illan is such a nice guy, a real hard worker and really good around the group. He’s great in training, very professional and a really positive guy to have around. He’s shown his level already in pre-season when he’s had the chance, so he’s a good addition for sure.
As for Christos, everyone has seen his qualities already - very energetic, very dangerous, and every time he gets on the ball he makes something happen. He’s a very intelligent player as well.

Bruno is a guy we all knew very well from before of course – we had a lot of battles with him! He’s been amazing since he came in, such a good player and you could see just from his 45 minutes last weekend how good he will be for us. He’s a player we always spoke about whenever we played Newcastle as someone who could dictate their game if we weren’t at our best, so it’s great to have him on our side now.

We’ve also said goodbye to a few players as well, which is part of football. It’s always hard to see guys leave after sharing so much together, and becoming close after living every day together. It happens with players and staff too, and with Leo especially, I would spend a lot of time with him. Christian Norgaard too – thanks to them all for everything they gave to the club. We’re going to miss them for sure, they are amazing guys. Of course we wish them all the best and hope they will be happy at their new clubs.

For us now we go into the new Premier League campaign with more confidence than ever before, having won it last season. We've shown that we can do it, now it's about showing that we can do it again. I think the mindset from everyone is that we don't feel like we're going to defend anything, we’re going to attack it and we’re going to go for it again.

Every season previously, when we hadn’t won it, I always said we need to learn from what we did, and make sure we improve. Well, it’s exactly the same when you win. You can still learn a lot from that, both the good and the bad. You need to analyse what you can improve, and also look at what we are doing well, and become even better at that too.

So this year let’s try to do it again, even better than before, even more than before, and there are more trophies to play for as well. I can feel that everyone is ready and hungry for more. You feel that when you've done it once, it gives you that extra confidence and maybe a little bit more calm, to know that you can do it again. We have to show that we are capable of doing it again, and that’s a good feeling, it’s a good boost for the start of the season.

And for me this is the best way to start, with an evening game at Emirates Stadium under the lights. We know Coventry will be giving absolutely everything as well, as a newly-promoted team, so we have no choice but to be at our best from the very first whistle.
We're really looking forward to being back on the pitch here in the Premier League, in front of all of our supporters. I know you will bring the energy and the noise again. We can’t wait.

items.titleZh: 厄德高谈神奇夏天与新赛季激动之情
items.summaryZh: 厄德高在队长专栏中回顾夺冠、世界杯及新援表现。
bodyZh: 在整个赛季中，马丁·厄德高将通过官方阿森纳比赛日节目撰写队长专栏，揭秘更衣室生活。
在此，为庆祝新赛季英超开赛，我们在考文垂城来访前完整转载他的专栏，队长畅谈夺冠情感、世界杯、社区盾最佳球员表现，以及新援们的状态：
首先，让我说上赛季末是多么神奇，衷心感谢每一位阿森纳支持者。
在塞尔赫斯特公园举起奖杯的感觉简直难以置信，那种感觉难以描述。当你长久以来如此努力追求的事情终于实现时，一切都不真实。我基本上一生都在梦想那一刻，所以当它发生时，一切都有些疯狂。当下很难理解和描述，但那太棒了。
我脑海中非常清晰，当我们赢得联赛冠军时，我们在训练基地相聚，举起奖杯，然后参加游行。看到你们这么多人在那里，真是难以置信。这对我们所有人来说都是一个特别的、特殊的记忆，将永远伴随我们。它展示了我们是一家多么伟大的俱乐部。我们衷心感谢你们。
之后我直接去了世界杯，那也很好。我们国家度过了一届伟大的赛事，比任何人预期的都要好。整个国家都像着火一样支持我们——我们在挪威从未见过这样的场面。比赛中的景象，以及看到那么多人聚在一起真正享受比赛，真的很特别。我们能够有这样的表现，让它更好了。
对我来说，亮点绝对是巴西那场比赛。从小到大，我们听过很多关于1998年世界杯挪威击败巴西的故事，那可能是我出生以来挪威足球的巅峰。所以有机会亲自击败他们真是太棒了！祝贺大卫、米克尔和祖比赢得世界杯。这对他们来说是巨大的成就，作为队友，我们为他们三人感到骄傲。
世界杯结束后，我有机会好好休息一下。基本上夏天剩下的时间我都待在挪威，和家人朋友在一起。天气很好，回家待一阵子，备战新赛季，真的很不错。
所以我感觉非常好，社区盾杯是回归竞技足球的完美方式。赢得奖杯是最好的回归方式，而且我们打得也很好，每个人的表现都很出色。
我也对自己的进球感到满意，那是团队精彩配合的结果。克里斯托斯在禁区边缘拿球，我只是在等着看能否得到球。我设法先碰到球，之后就是本能反应了。我并没有想太多，就是在那一刻完成了动作。然后当门将倒地时，轻松把球打进。也许你很少看到这种类型的进球，所以我很享受，那是个漂亮的进球。在我进球之前，我就听到身后的凯已经在庆祝了，这让我笑了！
我认为整体表现很强劲，尤其是队里还有一些新球员。伊兰、克里斯托斯和布鲁诺都适应得很好。伊兰是个很好的人，非常努力，在团队里也很受欢迎。他训练很出色，非常职业，而且是个积极的人。他在季前赛有机会时已经展现了自己的水平，所以肯定是个好的补充。
至于克里斯托斯，每个人都看到了他的特质——非常充满活力，非常有威胁，每次拿球都能制造机会。他也是一个非常聪明的球员。
布鲁诺是我们之前都很熟悉的人——我们和他有过很多次交手！他来了之后表现很棒，是个很出色的球员，你只需从上周末他上场45分钟就能看出他对我们有多好。在我们对阵纽卡斯尔时，我们总是谈论他是个能掌控比赛节奏的球员，如果我们不在最佳状态。所以现在他能加入我们，真是太棒了。
我们也告别了一些球员，这是足球的一部分。看到那些分享过这么多、每天一起生活而变得亲近的人离开，总是很难受。这对球员和工作人员来说都是如此，尤其是里奥，我会花很多时间和他在一起。还有克里斯蒂安·诺加德——感谢他们对俱乐部所做的一切。我们肯定会想念他们，他们都是很棒的人。当然，我们祝愿他们一切顺利，希望他们在新俱乐部开心。
现在，我们比以往任何时候都更有信心地进入新的英超赛季，因为上赛季我们赢得了冠军。我们已经证明我们能做到，现在关键是证明我们能再次做到。我认为每个人的心态都不是要防守什么，而是要进攻，再次去争取它。
之前每个赛季，当我们没有夺冠时，我总是说我们需要从所做事情中学习，确保进步。好吧，当你赢的时候也是一样的。你仍然可以从中学习很多，无论是好的还是坏的。你需要分析可以改进的地方，也要看看我们做得好的地方，并变得更好。
所以今年让我们再次尝试，比以前更好，比以前更多，而且还有更多奖杯可以争取。我能感觉到每个人都准备好了，渴望更多。当你做到过一次时，你会觉得给了你额外的信心，也许还有一点冷静，知道你可以再次做到。我们必须证明自己有能力再次做到，那是一种很好的感觉，对赛季开始是一种很好的推动。
对我来说，这是最好的开始方式，在酋长球场灯光下进行夜场。我们知道考文垂作为一支新升班马也会全力以赴，所以我们别无选择，必须从开场哨声响起就处于最佳状态。
我们非常期待回到英超赛场，回到所有支持者面前。我知道你们会再次带来能量和喧闹。我们等不及了。

items.titleEn: Preview: Arsenal v Coventry City
items.summaryEn: Get the latest team news, stats, TV coverage, tactics and more before our Premier League opener against the newly-promoted Sky Blues
bodyEn: For the first time in 22 years, we’ll start a Premier League season as reigning champions when we proudly stride out into Emirates Stadium to face Coventry City on Friday night (8pm UK).

Both teams will have enjoyed their summers basking in glory, with Frank Lampard guiding the Sky Blues back into the top-flight for the first time in 25 years by winning the Championship. However, with the world watching as the curtain rises on the 2026/27 Premier League season, a line will be drawn under those successes and new challenges laid out.

Like he has enjoyed in the previous four campaigns, Mikel Arteta will aim to start with a victory to ensure our quest to retain a league title for the first time since 1935 gets off to the perfect start, and maintain the feel-good factor that has engulfed north London for the past three months.
COVENTRY COMPLETE COMEBACK

A mainstay of the early Premier League years, this will be Coventry's first Premier League match in 25 years and 94 days, the longest gap between games by a side in the competition’s history. In that time they dropped as low as League Two for a solitary season in 2017/18, before Mark Robins guided them back into the Championship.

It was Lampard, however, who finally took them back into the promised land, winning the Championship with three games to spare in his first full season in charge, finishing 11 points clear of the rest of the division, with permanent deals for last season’s promotion heroes Carl Rushworth and Frank Onyeka completed this summer.

That has been part of a £123 million outlay, including Burnley winger Loum Tchaouna, Swiss international centre-back Aurele Amenda and Ghana midfielder Caleb Yirenkyi. Gustavo Hamer returned to the club after a stint at Sheffield United, while this week saw Lampard add two strikers in Taiwo Awoniyi and teenager Sidiki Cherif.
WHAT THE MANAGERS SAY

Arteta: "I feel good, different, hopefully better. More excited than ever. Hungrier than ever. I can't wait to start the Premier League at home in front of our supporters, have a great performance and win the match.

"We need to breathe and we need to take this organically because it's going to be a long marathon. What we need to show is that desire and ambition will be better than what we were last season, a month ago or a week ago when we played Manchester City. We have the ability to improve, to evolve and that's what I sense and I feel around the club and especially around the players."

Lampard: “I'm very excited to be here and get a club that's been out of the Premier League for 25 years back. It's exciting at this moment, but we want to challenge; we want to do well. It starts at Arsenal, you can’t start with a harder place to go.

"I want to show in our performance and how we approach the game that we're not coming into it with fear. We respect Arsenal greatly, but it doesn't mean you play with too much respect that you are passive. We can hopefully show we are a good team that want to do something this year."
TEAM NEWS

Bruno Guimaraes came off at half-time during our 3-0 Community Shield triumph against Manchester City last weekend and continues to be assessed, but Declan Rice and Bukayo Saka are available despite limited pre-season minutes.
Jurrien Timber continues to battle back from the groin injury that caused him to miss the World Cup and is edging closer to a return, but William Saliba is out longer-term with a back issue.

Coventry’s top scorer last season will be missing, as Haji Wright has been ruled out for a few months with a quad injury, with new signings Awoniyi or Cherif battling to start up front instead. Awoniyi has scored three times in his past five appearances against us.
Despite experiencing fitness issues during pre-season, Ephron Mason-Clark and Jack Rudoni are fit to feature at Emirates Stadium.
TALKING TACTICS

Adrian Clarke, writing in the official matchday programme: In the second tier, Coventry City averaged over 55% possession, producing a nice brand of fast-paced football. In possession, Lampard’s men will look to pass it short through the thirds and release their wide men into 1v1 situations, while they also pay great attention to set pieces, scoring a league-high 29 goals from those situations.

If Lampard opts for his trusty 4-2-3-1 system, he will likely drop his No. 10 a little deeper to set up in a 4-5-1 without the ball. In tougher tests, the Sky Blues tend to focus greater attention on pressing, and fellow promoted side Ipswich Town were the only outfit to attempt more shots from high turnovers last term.

Ever since Lampard became their head coach, they have regularly put a stream of deliveries into the box, scoring lots of headers, with front men Ellis Simms, Wright and centre-back Bobby Thomas the primary targets last term.

The Sky Blues also have a top-class keeper in Rushworth whose shot-stopping skills and expert distribution are eye-catching, while the late runs of attacking midfielder Rudoni are similar to those of his manager’s trademark during his playing days.
FACTS AND STATS

This is the first Premier League meeting between Coventry and us since February 2001, when we won 1-0 at Highfield Road. Coventry have won just one of the last 14 top-flight meetings, a 3-2 win on Boxing Day 1999.
This will be the fifth time the defending Premier League champions will meet the second-tier champions on the opening day, with the top-flight winners winning each of the previous four.
We have won our opening match in each of the last four Premier League seasons, and have won five in a row only once before in our league history, between 2001/02 and 2005/06.

This will be Coventry’s first league match at Emirates Stadium, though they’ve lost there twice in the League Cup. Only two teams (including us) have won their first ever league match at the ground – West Ham in April 2007 and Hull City in September 2008.

Since the start of 2023/24, we have won 17 of our 18 Premier League games against promoted sides, with the exception of a 2-2 draw at Sunderland last season. At home, we are unbeaten in 45 Premier League home games against promoted sides, the longest such run by any team in the competition’s history (W40 D5).
Mikel Arteta is unbeaten in his five games against Frank Lampard’s teams in all competitions, winning the last four in a row.

Arteta has won 149 of his 248 Premier League games in charge. Victory here would see him become just the fifth manager to reach 150 victories in fewer than 250 games in the competition, after Pep Guardiola (204), Jose Mourinho (231), Jurgen Klopp (237), and Alex Ferguson (247).
Since the start of March, Christos Tzolis has either scored or assisted in all 15 of his competitive appearances at club level (10 goals, 15 assists).
MATCH OFFICIALS

The honour of getting the Premier League season underway falls to Tom Bramall, with the Sheffield-based official taking charge of just his third Gunners game. The previous two came last season, as we beat Crystal Palace 1-0 and overcame Mansfield Town 2-1 in the FA Cup.

Coventry have won three of the seven games he has overseen, with the last in February when they beat promotion rivals Middlesbrough, and he also awarded the Sky Blues a penalty. Bramall was handed 22 top-flight games last term, averaging four cards per game, but only sent off two players and pointed to the spot six times.
Referee: Tom BramallAssistants: Gary Beswick, Mat WilkesFourth official: Adam HerczegVAR: Jarred GillettAssistant VAR: Neil Davies
PREVIOUS MEETINGS

We are unbeaten in our last 10 home games against Coventry in all competitions, winning each of the last seven, including two cup matches during the Sky Blues’ top-flight exile. We prevailed 4-0 in the last meeting back in January 2014, when a Lukas Podolski brace was followed by strikes from Olivier Giroud and Santi Cazorla in the FA Cup fourth round.

In September 2012 we went goal-crazy against the Sky Blues again, netting six in the League Cup third round. Giroud got the scoring underway before Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain, Andrei Arshavin, a Theo Walcott double and Ignasi Miquel all netted.
The last Premier League fixture in north London came in September 2000 when Sylvain Wiltord and Paulo Vernazza scored their first Gunners goals to hand us a 2-1 victory.
LIVE COVERAGE
We're back Live from N5 with Nicole Holliday and Jeremie Aliadiere providing all the best build-up from Emirates Stadium,
They'll be joined in the studio by former Gunner Carl Jenkinson who recently retired, as well as Arsenal Women icon Alex Scott and actors Ben Hardy and Saffron Hocking

We'll crown our heroes of the summer, look back at the recent Live from Sobha season kick-off show, relive some opening day memories and play some quizzes before handing over to Dan Roebuck and Adrian Clarke for live commentary of all the opening action.
You can also find out which broadcasters are showing the action live, wherever you are in the world.
CHECK BEFORE YOU TRAVEL
For those attending tonight's match against Coventry are reminded to check their routes into N5.
This is due to disruptions on the Piccadilly and Victoria London Underground Lines.
A reduced service on the Victoria Line is affecting Highbury & Islington and Finsbury Park stations due to a track defect (there are due to be almost 50% fewer trains per hour).
In addition, there will be no eastbound Piccadilly Line services at Caledonian Road station. Check the TfL website for more!

items.titleZh: 前瞻：阿森纳vs考文垂城
items.summaryZh: 英超揭幕战前，获取阿森纳对阵考文垂的最新球队新闻、数据、转播和战术信息。
bodyZh: 22年来，我们将首次以卫冕冠军身份开始英超赛季，周五晚上（英国时间8点）自豪地踏入酋长球场迎战考文垂城。
两支球队都度过了享受荣耀的夏天，弗兰克·兰帕德带领天蓝军团赢得英冠冠军，时隔25年重返顶级联赛。然而，随着2026/27赛季英超大幕拉开，世人瞩目之下，过去的成功将被划上句号，新的挑战随之而来。
与前四个赛季一样，米克尔·阿尔特塔的目标是以胜利开局，确保我们自1935年以来首次卫冕联赛冠军的征程有一个完美开端，并延续过去三个月席卷北伦敦的良好氛围。
考文垂完成回归
作为英超早期的常客，这将是考文垂时隔25年零94天再次参加英超比赛，这是英超历史上球队间隔时间最长的一次。在此期间，他们曾在2017/18赛季降入英乙，只待了一个赛季，随后马克·罗宾斯带领他们重返英冠。
然而，正是兰帕德最终将他们带回了应许之地。在他执教的首个完整赛季中，他提前三场赢得英冠冠军，领先英冠其他球队11分。今年夏天，上赛季升级功臣卡尔·拉什沃思和弗兰克·奥涅卡也完成了永久转会。
这是1.23亿英镑支出的一部分，其中包括伯恩利边锋卢姆·查乌纳、瑞士国脚中卫奥雷勒·阿门达和加纳中场凯莱布·伊伦基。古斯塔沃·哈默在谢菲尔德联效力一段时间后回归俱乐部，而本周兰帕德又引进了两名前锋：泰沃·阿沃尼伊和年轻球员西迪基·谢里夫。
主教练言论
阿尔特塔：“我感觉很好，有所不同，希望更好。比以往任何时候都更兴奋，比以往任何时候都更渴望。我迫不及待地想在主场球迷面前开始英超联赛，拿出出色表现并赢得比赛。”
“我们需要深呼吸，自然地对待这一切，因为这将是一场漫长的马拉松。我们需要展示的是比上赛季、一个月前或一周前对阵曼城时更强的渴望和雄心。我们有能力提高和进化，这是我在俱乐部周围，尤其是球员们身上感受到的。”
兰帕德：“我非常兴奋能来到这里，让一支离开英超25年的俱乐部重返顶级联赛。此刻令人激动，但我们想要挑战，想要表现出色。从阿森纳开始，没有比这更艰难的开局了。”
“我想通过我们的表现和比赛方式来展示，我们不会带着恐惧作战。我们非常尊重阿森纳，但这并不意味着你过于尊重而变得被动。希望我们能展示自己是一支想要在今年有所作为的好球队。”
球队新闻
在上周末对阵曼城的社区盾杯3-0胜利中，布鲁诺·吉马良斯半场被换下，他仍在接受评估。尽管季前赛出场时间有限，德克兰·赖斯和布卡约·萨卡可以出战。
尤里安·廷贝尔继续与腹股沟伤病作斗争，这让他错过了世界杯，目前他接近复出。但威廉·萨利巴因背部问题将长期缺阵。
考文垂上赛季的最佳射手将缺席，哈吉·赖特因大腿伤势将缺阵数月，新援阿沃尼伊或谢里夫将竞争首发前锋位置。阿沃尼伊在过去五次对阵我们的比赛中打入三球。
尽管季前赛期间有健康问题，埃弗龙·梅森-克拉克和杰克·鲁多尼仍可参加酋长球场的比赛。
战术讨论
阿德里安·克拉克在官方比赛日节目中写道：在英冠联赛中，考文垂平均控球率超过55%，踢出了快速流畅的足球。在控球时，兰帕德的球队会寻求短传推进，并让边路球员进入一对一局面，同时他们非常重视定位球，通过定位球打入29球，为联赛最高。
如果兰帕德选择他信赖的4-2-3-1阵型，他可能会将10号位球员稍微后撤，在无球时形成4-5-1。在更艰难的考验中，天蓝军团往往更注重逼抢，上赛季只有同为升班马的伊普斯维奇在高位夺回球权后的射门次数更多。
自从兰帕德成为主教练以来，他们经常向禁区输送大量传中，打入许多头球，上赛季主要目标是前锋埃利斯·西姆斯、赖特和中卫博比·托马斯。
天蓝军团还有一位顶级门将拉什沃思，他的扑救能力和出色传球技术令人瞩目，而攻击型中场鲁多尼的后插上跑动与他主教练球员时代标志性的跑位相似。
事实与数据
这是自2001年2月以来，考文垂与我们在英超的首次交锋，当时我们在海菲尔德路1-0获胜。在过往14次顶级联赛交锋中，考文垂仅胜一场，即1999年节礼日的3-2获胜。
这将是卫冕英超冠军在揭幕战中对阵英冠冠军的第五次，此前四次均为顶级联赛冠军获胜。
我们已在过去四个英超赛季的揭幕战中获胜，而我们联赛历史上仅有过一次五连胜开局，即2001/02至2005/06赛季。
这将是考文垂在酋长球场的首场联赛，不过他们曾在联赛杯中两次在这里失利。只有两支球队（包括我们）在这座球场赢得了队史首场联赛——2007年4月的西汉姆联和2008年9月的赫尔城。
自2023/24赛季开始以来，我们在18场对阵升班马的英超比赛中赢了17场，唯一例外是上赛季客场2-2战平桑德兰。在主场，我们对阵升班马已保持45场英超不败，这是英超历史上任何球队最长的不败纪录（40胜5平）。
米克尔·阿尔特塔在各项赛事中对阵弗兰克·兰帕德执教的球队5场不败，并取得最近四连胜。
阿尔特塔执教阿森纳的248场英超比赛中赢了149场。如果本场获胜，他将成为英超历史上第五位在不到250场比赛中取得150胜的主教练，此前四位是佩普·瓜迪奥拉（204场）、何塞·穆里尼奥（231场）、尤尔根·克洛普（237场）和亚历克斯·弗格森（247场）。
自3月初以来，克里斯托斯·佐利斯在俱乐部级别的全部15场正式比赛中均有进球或助攻（10球，15助攻）。
比赛官员
开启英超赛季的荣誉落在了汤姆·布拉马尔身上，这位来自谢菲尔德的裁判将执法他执教阿森纳的第三场比赛。此前两场都在上赛季，我们1-0击败水晶宫，以及足总杯2-1战胜曼斯菲尔德。
考文垂在他执法的7场比赛中赢了3场，最近一场是2月击败升级对手米德尔斯堡，他还判给天蓝军团一个点球。布拉马尔上赛季执法了22场英超比赛，场均出示4张牌，但只罚下2名球员，判罚6个点球。
主裁判：汤姆·布拉马尔；助理裁判：加里·贝斯维克、马特·威尔克斯；第四官员：亚当·赫尔采格；VAR：贾里德·吉莱特；助理VAR：尼尔·戴维斯
过往交锋
我们在各项赛事中最近10次主场对考文垂保持不败，赢下其中最近7场，包括天蓝军团离开顶级联赛期间的两次杯赛。上一次交手是2014年1月的足总杯第四轮，我们4-0获胜，当时卢卡斯·波多尔斯基梅开二度，奥利维尔·吉鲁和桑蒂·卡索拉各入一球。
2012年9月，我们在联赛杯第三轮再次对天蓝军团掀起进球狂潮，打入六球。吉鲁首开纪录，随后亚历克斯·张伯伦、安德烈·阿尔沙文、西奥·沃尔科特梅开二度和伊格纳西·米克尔都有进球。
上一次在英超北伦敦交锋是在2000年9月，西尔万·维尔托德和保罗·韦尔纳扎打入他们在阿森纳的处子球，帮助我们2-1获胜。
直播报道
我们回到N5的现场直播，妮可·霍利迪和杰雷米·阿利亚迭雷将从酋长球场带来最精彩的赛前报道。
前阿森纳球员、最近退役的卡尔·詹金森将加入演播室，还有阿森纳女足偶像亚历克斯·斯科特，以及演员本·哈迪和萨弗龙·霍金。
我们将评选出夏季英雄，回顾最近的Sobha直播赛季揭幕节目，重温一些揭幕战回忆，并进行一些问答，然后交给丹·罗巴克和阿德里安·克拉克进行现场解说，带来所有开场动作。
您还可以了解世界各地哪些转播商将直播本场比赛。
出行前查询
提醒今晚参加对阵考文垂比赛的观众，请查询前往N5的路线。
这是因为伦敦地铁皮卡迪利线和维多利亚线出现运营中断。
由于轨道缺陷，维多利亚线减少服务，影响海布里与伊斯灵顿站和芬斯伯里公园站（每小时列车将减少近50%）。
此外，卡利多尼亚路站的皮卡迪利线东行服务将暂停。请访问TfL网站了解更多信息！

items.titleEn: U21s preview: Arsenal v Crystal Palace
items.summaryEn: We kick-off our Premier League 2 campaign at home to Crystal Palace on Saturday afternoon
bodyEn: Our under-21s kick off their Premier League 2 campaign on Saturday afternoon with a London derby against Crystal Palace at Mangata Developments Stadium. Kick-off in north London is scheduled for 1pm (UK).
Last season, we maintained our 100% record of qualifying for the Premier League play-offs with a 14th-place finish in the 29-team league table.

A new season starts with a new manager for our under-21s, who will be guided by David Horseman this season. The English coach took charge of our EFL Trophy and UEFA Youth League fixtures last season, and will also be at the helm for our Premier League 2 games in 2026/27.
THE OPPOSITION
Like ourselves, the Eagles finished in the top 16 of last season's table to ensure progress to the end-of-season play-offs.
A tenth-place finish set up a thrilling knockout tie with Liverpool, a game Palace won on penalties after both sides scored in extra time in a 3-3 draw.
But having eliminated the Reds from the play-offs, Palace found themselves on the wrong end of their quarter-final result, losing 2-0 at home to eventual runners-up Manchester United.
The south London side came out on top in our league meeting last season, scoring either side of half-time to beat us 2-0 in the final game of the regular season.
HOW TO FOLLOW
The action gets underway from 1pm (UK) at Meadow Park, with live updates available throughout the match on our Academy X account.
Post-match, don't miss exclusive interviews with new under-21s Head Coach David Horseman and one of his young Gunners, as well as highlights of all the key action from the contest.

items.titleZh: U21前瞻：阿森纳 vs 水晶宫
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳U21周六主场迎战水晶宫，开启英超2赛季。
bodyZh: 我们的U21队将于周六下午在曼加塔发展球场（Mangata Developments Stadium）迎来与水晶宫的伦敦德比，开启英超2赛季。比赛在伦敦北部举行，开球时间为英国时间下午1点。
上赛季，我们在29支球队的积分榜上排名第14位，保持了100%晋级英超附加赛的记录。
新赛季，我们的U21队迎来了新主帅，本赛季将由大卫·霍斯曼执教。这位英格兰教练上赛季负责了我们的英格兰足球联赛锦标赛和欧洲青年联赛的比赛，他将在2026/27赛季继续执掌我们的英超2赛事。
对手情况
与我们一样，老鹰（水晶宫）上赛季名列积分榜前16名，确保了进入赛季末的附加赛。
第十名的成绩让他们与利物浦上演了一场激动人心的淘汰赛，双方在加时赛中均有进球，最终战成3-3平，水晶宫在点球大战中获胜。
但在淘汰了红军（利物浦）之后，水晶宫在四分之一决赛中遭遇失利，主场0-2不敌最终获得亚军的曼联。
这支南伦敦球队在上赛季的联赛交锋中胜出，他们在上半场结束前后各入一球，在常规赛最后一场比赛中2-0击败了我们。
如何关注
比赛将于英国时间下午1点在草甸公园（Meadow Park）打响，整个比赛期间，我们将在青训学院X账号上提供实时更新。
赛后，不要错过对U21新主帅大卫·霍斯曼和他的一名年轻枪手的独家采访，以及比赛所有关键动作的集锦。

bodyEn: While Myles Lewis-Skelly looks likely to remain at the Emirates, the same can’t be said for Ethan Nwaneri. The 19-year-old was outstanding in his breakthrough season for Arsenal in 2024-25 but barely featured last season and was sent on loan to Marseille. That didn’t really work out and Arsenal are now exploring another temporary move to ensure Nwaneri gets regular football this season. Milan, RB Leipzig, Dortmund and Fulham are all thought to be interested, with Nwaneri unlikely to feature on the bench for Friday’s opener against Coventry as a result. Whether Gabriel Martinelli and Gabriel Jesus are available remains to be seen as Arsenal attempt to find suitors for the Brazil duo. Ed Aarons
Arsenal v Coventry City, Friday 8pm (all times BST)

Manchester United’s summer transfer business has focused on recruiting in central midfield. It will be interesting to see who Michael Carrick selects in two key roles for the first game of the season. Andrey Santos and Youri Tielemans have been present for more of pre-season than Kobbie Mainoo, who did not play a minute for England at the World Cup and was a late returner to Carrington after a holiday. Carlos Baleba surely will not have arrived in time to start at Hull. Mainoo is in the best position in the long term but if Carrick decides to ease him into the season, it would be intriguing to see how Santos and Tielemans team up, the stress test for a new partnership that could provide the perfect balance of defensive awareness and ability to move the team up the pitch. Will Unwin
Hull City v Manchester United, Saturday 12.30pm

Neither Everton nor Crystal Palace have enjoyed a particularly scintillating summer of transfer activity but combined to make headlines with a swap deal between Dwight McNeil and Brennan Johnson. The pair will face one another – and their former clubs - on the first weekend of the season, eager to prove what their worth to their new teams. McNeil was rarely a regular on Merseyside but had a positive second half to last season, ironically after a move to Crystal Palace fell through at the last minute. Johnson did not settle at Selhurst Park, unable to crack the code that would get him into the starting lineup on a weekly basis, after moving from Spurs. A fresh start should reinvigorate the duo and there is no better way to further boost the mood than beating a former employer. WU
Everton v Crystal Palace, Saturday 3pm

Ipswich clearly learned a lot from what Sunderland did a year ago, as they went out and bought a lot of players. The Black Cats quickly moulded their 19 acquisitions into a successful unit but at least they had the positive of a head coach in Régis Le Bris who had his feet under the table. Gary O’Neil is the new man at Portman Road and he has 12 signings – at time of writing – to potentially use for the opener. The record arrival, Emersonn, who has moved to Portman Road from Toulouse, is the most eye-catching of those who have been acquired. The Brazilian has an underwhelming career goalscoring record and a few question marks hanging over his head. Even though it is their first game, Ipswich need to pick up points at home, and to do so require a striker who can cause problems for defenders. How quickly Emersonn adapts will be critical for the Tractor Boys’ success this year. WU
Ipswich Town v Sunderland, Saturday 3pm

August is the season for debuts and no one will be more satisfied than Oliver Glasner when Ousmane Diomande steps over the white line at the City Ground. Glasner wanted the Ivorian centre-back to replace Marc Guéhi at Crystal Palace, six months before the England defender departed for Manchester City. Diomande, a £34m buy from Sporting, is expected to line up in a back three for Nottingham Forest against Leeds, when the Austria midfielder Xaver Schlager, who played for Glasner at Wolfsburg, could also make his Forest bow. Diomande is a quick and physical defender but another aspect of his appeal is his aerial power at set pieces. “They’ve both played Champions League football and they are used to competing for titles,” said Glasner. “They can add this winning mentality.” Ben Fisher
Nottingham Forest v Leeds, Saturday 3pm

Cristian Romero has taken his maverick brand of defending to Atlético Madrid, upsetting neutral Premier League watchers. His compatriot Marcos Senesi has arrived to shore up things at the back as Roberto De Zerbi desperately tries to steer Spurs away from a third straight season of battling relegation. The all-action Romero had his qualities as a leader and defender but never felt dependable, which is what most want from a centre-back and captain. Senesi impressed during his time at Bournemouth, rarely making headlines but proving himself a calm presence at the back. The Argentinian is good on the ball and will be more adventurous in possession than his countryman. He is yet to be sent off in three seasons as a Premier League player – Romero was dismissed twice in 2025-26 alone, not to mention a one-match ban and a fine for his behaviour towards a referee. His calmness will improve Spurs. WU
Brentford v Tottenham, Saturday 5.30pm

It is surely not how Unai Emery envisaged the countdown to Aston Villa’s season-opener at Brighton on Sunday – and certainly not as he enjoyed the afterglow from the club’s Europa League triumph over Freiburg in May. The manager has an extraordinary number of problems. Take the midfield where the new signings João Gomes and Johan Manzambi are injury doubts. Note: Amadou Onana is a long-term casualty while Youri Tielemans has been sold. It goes on. Emery is about to lose Ezri Konsa to Arsenal – in a summer where Villa have also sold Morgan Rogers and Lucas Digne. They are trying to move on Emi Martínez, while the future of Ollie Watkins is uncertain, with Al-Hilal circling. For the cherry on top, the rampaging 17-year-old striker Brian Madjo is a fitness concern. Emery’s teamsheet will be very interesting. Will he pitch the new goalkeeper, Zion Suzuki, who only signed on Wednesday, straight in? David Hytner
Brighton v Aston Villa, Sunday 2pm

Is Enzo Maresca already under pressure after Manchester City’s 3-0 schooling by Arsenal in the Community Shield? Maybe not, but if the Italian’s new team go down at home to Bournemouth on Sunday, you do not have to be a soothsayer to picture the scrutiny that will follow. Maresca and City are enduring a difficult transfer window, with Rodri’s departure to Barcelona the headline, a dizzying blow that has to be shaken off. The new Bournemouth coach, Marco Rose, has faced City six times in the Champions League with Leipzig and Mönchengladbach, and is sure to order his visitors to go for the jugular at the Etihad. City are vulnerable but Maresca can remedy this with a win of any sort. This, after all, is the job many felt he was the obvious choice for. Jamie Jackson
Manchester City v Bournemouth, Sunday 2pm

Kevin Keegan was supposed to have been the guest of honour at St James’ Park on Sunday, but his death from cancer in July means this meeting of two of his old clubs will turn into a tribute to one of English football’s enduring heroes. Keegan’s family will be present to witness an outpouring of love for the former Liverpool and Newcastle forward and (twice) Magpies manager. Once the game kicks off, all eyes will be on Alexander Isak, a St James’ Park old boy whose decision to force a £125m move to Anfield last summer did not go down well on Tyneside. The Sweden striker, making his first return to Newcastle, has much to prove at Liverpool, and now has a new head coach to impress in Andoni Iraola. Newcastle too have a new face in the home dugout, where Matthias Jaissle will occupy the technical area for so long inhabited by Eddie Howe. Louise Taylor
Newcastle v Liverpool, Sunday 4.30pm

Real Madrid’s two head coaches from last season meet at Craven Cottage, with the focus on Xabi Alonso, rather than Álvaro Arbeloa. The Fulham man, however, may have more to prove in the Premier League. His managerial career has been less prominent than that of his Basque rival – and he has clearly insisted on snapping up talent from the Bernabéu. Gonzalo García and César Palacios have made the trip over from the Spanish capital with Arbeloa. It shows great faith from the former Liverpool defender but it does put extra pressure on the trio, their fates now permanently intertwined. All three need a positive start to show they merit being in the Premier League. Otherwise, it would be very easily to criticise them individually and collectively. WU
Fulham v Chelsea, Monday 8pm

items.titleZh: 英超：新赛季开赛值得关注的10件事
items.summaryZh: 曼联新中场亮相，伊普斯维奇雄心受考验，纽卡斯尔致敬基冈。
bodyZh: 尽管迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利看来很可能留在酋长球场，但伊桑·恩瓦内里情况不同。这位19岁球员在2024-25赛季为阿森纳取得突破，表现出色，但上赛季几乎未获出场机会，并被租借至马赛。那次租借并不成功，阿森纳现在正在探索另一次临时转会，以确保恩瓦内里本赛季能获得稳定出场时间。据信米兰、莱比锡红牛、多特蒙德和富勒姆都有意，因此恩瓦内里可能不会出现在周五对阵考文垂的揭幕战替补席上。加布里埃尔·马丁内利和加布里埃尔·热苏斯是否留队仍有待观察，因为阿森纳正为这对巴西组合寻找买家。——埃德·阿伦斯
阿森纳对阵考文垂城，周五晚8点（均为英国夏令时）

曼联的夏季转会操作重点集中在中场引援上。值得关注的是，迈克尔·卡里克将在新赛季首战中如何选择两个关键位置的人选。安德烈·桑托斯和尤里·蒂勒曼斯参加了更多季前赛，而科比·梅努在世界杯上未代表英格兰出场一分钟，度假后也较晚才回到卡灵顿。卡洛斯·巴莱巴肯定无法及时赶到赫尔城首发。长期来看，梅努处于最佳位置，但如果卡里克决定让他慢慢适应赛季，那么桑托斯和蒂勒曼斯如何搭档将很有意思，这是对新组合的考验，他们可能提供防守意识和推进球队能力的完美平衡。——威尔·昂温
赫尔城对阵曼联，周六12点30分

埃弗顿和水晶宫在这个夏天的转会操作都不算特别精彩，但一笔涉及德怀特·麦克尼尔和布伦南·约翰逊的互换交易却让他们一起登上了头条。两人将在新赛季首周对阵彼此——以及他们的前东家，急于向新东家证明自己的价值。麦克尼尔在默西塞德很少成为常规主力，但上赛季后半段表现积极，讽刺的是，此前他转会水晶宫的计划在最后时刻告吹。约翰逊从热刺转会后，在塞尔赫斯特公园未能站稳脚跟，始终无法破解每周进入首发的难题。新的开始应该能让这对组合重振旗鼓，而没有什么比击败前东家更能提升士气了。——威尔·昂温
埃弗顿对阵水晶宫，周六下午3点

伊普斯维奇显然从桑德兰一年前的做法中汲取了教训，他们买进了大量球员。黑猫队迅速将19名新援整合成一个成功的整体，但他们至少拥有一个优势，那就是主教练雷吉斯·勒布里斯已经站稳了脚跟。加里·奥尼尔是波特曼路球场的新任主帅，截至发稿时，他有12名签约球员可供首战使用。创纪录的新援埃默松从图卢兹转会而来，是最引人注目的引援。这位巴西球员职业生涯进球记录并不出色，头顶上也悬着几个问号。尽管这是他们的首场比赛，伊普斯维奇也需要在主场拿分，而要做到这一点，他们需要一名能给对方后卫制造麻烦的前锋。埃默松适应的速度将对“拖拉机男孩”本赛季的成功至关重要。——威尔·昂温
伊普斯维奇对阵桑德兰，周六下午3点

八月是新援首秀的季节，当奥斯曼·迪奥曼德踏入城市球场的白线时，没有人会比奥利弗·格拉斯纳更满意。格拉斯纳曾希望这位科特迪瓦中卫在水晶宫接替马克·格伊，而六个月后，这位英格兰后卫便转会去了曼城。迪奥曼德以3400万英镑从葡萄牙体育签下，预计将在诺丁汉森林对阵利兹联的比赛中出任三中卫之一，而曾在沃尔夫斯堡为格拉斯纳效力的奥地利中场克萨韦尔·施拉格也可能迎来森林首秀。迪奥曼德是一位速度与身体素质兼备的后卫，但另一个吸引人的方面是他在定位球中的空中优势。“他们都踢过欧冠，习惯了争夺冠军，”格拉斯纳说。“他们能带来这种赢家心态。”——本·费舍尔
诺丁汉森林对阵利兹联，周六下午3点

克里斯蒂安·罗梅罗将他的特立独行防守风格带到了马德里竞技，这让中立的英超球迷感到不满。他的同胞马科斯·塞内西已经加盟，以巩固后防，与此同时，罗伯托·德泽尔比拼命试图让热刺避免连续第三个赛季为保级而战。全能型的罗梅罗具备领袖和后卫的品质，但从未让人感到可靠，而这是大多数人对中卫和队长的期望。塞内西在伯恩茅斯效力期间给人留下深刻印象，虽然很少上头条，但证明了自己在后防线上的冷静存在。这位阿根廷球员脚下技术出色，持球时比他的同胞更具冒险精神。他在三个英超赛季中从未被红牌罚下——而罗梅罗仅2025-26赛季就被罚下两次，更不用说他因对裁判的行为而遭到禁赛一场和罚款。他的冷静将提升热刺的表现。——威尔·昂温
布伦特福德对阵热刺，周六下午5点30分

这肯定不是乌奈·埃梅里对周日阿斯顿维拉客场挑战布莱顿的赛季揭幕战所设想的倒计时方式——尤其是在五月俱乐部欧联杯战胜弗赖堡后还沉浸在喜悦中的他。这位主帅面临着大量问题。以中场为例，新援若昂·戈麦斯和约翰·曼赞比有伤疑。注意：阿马杜·奥纳纳长期缺阵，而尤里·蒂勒曼斯已被出售。这还没完。埃梅里即将失去将转会阿森纳的埃兹里·孔萨——在这个夏天，维拉已经出售了摩根·罗杰斯和卢卡斯·迪涅。他们还在试图送走埃米·马丁内斯，而奥利·沃特金斯的未来也不确定，利雅得新月虎视眈眈。更糟糕的是，生猛的17岁前锋布莱恩·马乔也存在健康问题。埃梅里的出场名单将非常有趣。他会让周三才签约的新门将锡安·铃木直接首发吗？——大卫·海特纳
布莱顿对阵阿斯顿维拉，周日下午2点

在曼城社区盾杯被阿森纳3-0教训后，恩佐·马雷斯卡是否已经承受压力？也许没有，但如果这位意大利人的新球队周日在主场输给伯恩茅斯，你无需预言家也能想象随之而来的审视。马雷斯卡和曼城正在经历一个艰难的转会窗口，罗德里转会巴塞罗那成为头条新闻，这是一个令人眩晕的打击，必须尽快摆脱。伯恩茅斯新帅马尔科·罗泽在执教莱比锡和门兴时曾在欧冠六次面对曼城，他肯定会命令客队在伊蒂哈德球场直击要害。曼城很脆弱，但马雷斯卡可以用一场胜利来补救。毕竟，这是他许多人认为理所当然的工作。——杰米·杰克逊
曼城对阵伯恩茅斯，周日下午2点

凯文·基冈本应周日作为圣詹姆斯公园的荣誉嘉宾出席，但他于七月因癌症去世，这意味着这场比赛，他两支老东家的交锋，将变成对这位英格兰足球永恒英雄之一的致敬。基冈的家人将到场，见证人们对这位前利物浦和纽卡斯尔前锋、两度执教喜鹊的主帅表达的热爱。比赛开始后，所有目光都将聚焦亚历山大·伊萨克，这位圣詹姆斯公园旧将去年夏天强行以1.25亿英镑转会安菲尔德，这一举动在泰恩赛德并不受欢迎。这位瑞典前锋首次重返纽卡斯尔，他需要在利物浦证明很多，现在还要给新任主帅安东尼·伊劳拉留下好印象。纽卡斯尔在主场教练席上也有新面孔，马蒂亚斯·耶斯勒将占据埃迪·豪长期占据的技术区域。——路易丝·泰勒
纽卡斯尔对阵利物浦，周日下午4点30分

皇家马德里上赛季的两位主教练在克拉文农场相遇，焦点集中在哈维·阿隆索身上，而不是阿尔瓦罗·阿韦洛亚。然而，富勒姆人阿韦洛亚在英超可能更需要证明自己。他的执教生涯不如他的巴斯克对手那样突出——而且他显然坚持从伯纳乌引进人才。贡萨洛·加西亚和塞萨尔·帕拉西奥斯随阿韦洛亚一同从西班牙首都来到伦敦。这体现了这位前利物浦后卫的极大信任，但也给三人带来了额外压力，他们的命运现在永久地交织在一起。三人都需要积极的开局来证明他们配得上英超。否则，很容易对他们个人和集体进行批评。——威尔·昂温
富勒姆对阵切尔西，周一晚8点

bodyEn: Mikel Arteta wants to get his messaging absolutely right. According to him, Arsenal are not about to defend their Premier League title. They are set to attack another one.

Remember Win the dog, who the manager brought in to the club’s training ground a few years back? She must now be called “Won”. But it is when Arteta quibbles over another bout of semantics that he highlights why he is entering the new season with such energy and optimism.

Do not talk to him about Arsenal’s stability. He prefers the word “consistency” along with more thrusting ones like “ambition”. The overall theme is clear. When Arteta surveys the landscape at the top end of the English game, he sees a settled environment at his club and flux elsewhere.

In terms of the so-called Big Six – the richest clubs in the country, as ranked by Deloitte – there are new managers at Manchester City, Liverpool and Chelsea; a virtually new one at Tottenham and a relatively new one at Manchester United. It has been a summer of unprecedented change in the Premier League with nine clubs with a new man in charge. Of those who hold out hope of a title challenge, only Aston Villa have a fully bedded-in manager in Unai Emery.

Rather abruptly, Arteta finds himself as the longest-serving manager in the division; he took over from Emery at Arsenal in December 2019. Emery is second on the list, having been at Villa for three years and nine months, and only one other – Daniel Farke at Leeds – has been at his club for more than three years.

When Arteta was given the job at Arsenal, Pep Guardiola was two titles into his storied City tenure, Jürgen Klopp had won the Champions League at Liverpool and was on his way to winning the league that season and José Mourinho had just joined Spurs.
Arteta has seen them all off, with Guardiola’s departure from City at the end of last season being the most significant single shift in the dynamics for the forthcoming campaign.

Arteta is now the big beast, the only current manager to have won the Premier League, and as Arsenal prepare for the curtain-raiser at home to Coventry on Friday night, it is hard to ignore the confidence they are projecting. With virtually of all their rivals in transition, uncertainty undercutting the excitement, predictions difficult to make in the face of little actual evidence, Arsenal are reassured by their firm foundations. They sense opportunity, another title; the creation of a dynasty. That is the ultimate goal.

There is something more. Namely how everything changed for them in the closing weeks of last season. City had done the hard work, clawing back a nine-point deficit from the middle of March – a period when they had a game in hand. But in the five-match shootout that followed, City blinked first, drawing at Everton. Most know how nerve-racking it was for Arsenal. Not least Arteta. The Emirates Stadium was a sea of anxiety when Arsenal last played there – against Burnley in the penultimate game of the season. They got a 1-0 win over the line.

Then City drew at Bournemouth and it was over; Arsenal’s 22-year wait, the oppressive weight. It is impossible to underestimate the feeling of liberation. Nobody can question the bottle of this team. Nobody will taunt them with the cry of “second again, olé, olé.” It is plain Arteta and his players will feed off it and perhaps it will lead to a more expansive style of football. The fear of falling short inhibited their game as the heat rose last time out.

Arsenal have made changes behind the scenes, looking for the marginal gains, most notably in the medical department where the head doctor, Zafar Iqbal, was mutually consented in early June. Arnaldo Abrantes has come in from Aston Villa to replace him. If the players can stay fitter for longer, Arsenal believe they can stay ahead. They have protected themselves with moves to deepen an already well-stocked squad. Bruno Guimarães is the most eye-catching addition, with Ezri Konsa about to follow.

Arsenal versus City still feels like the primary head-to-head. Guardiola had Arteta’s number last season, winning two and drawing one of the three meetings between the clubs. City were much the better team in the Carabao Cup final that they won 2-0. But that was under Guardiola and that was with Rodri and Bernardo Silva. If Guardiola’s exit has hit City the hardest, then those of the commanding midfielders to Barcelona and Real Madrid, respectively, is not far behind.

City’s faith in their new manager, Enzo Maresca, is rooted in what they saw of him when he worked on their coaching staff; he was an assistant to Guardiola in the treble-winning season of 2022-23. Previously, he coached the Under‑23s to the Premier League 2 title in 2020-21.

It is a well-thought-through appointment; the kind a well-run club makes. Yet at the same time, it is not one to quicken the pulse. Maresca, quite simply, has enormous shoes to fill. Ditto Elliot Anderson, the impressive young midfielder upon whom City have bet the house. Can City be better given the personnel losses they have sustained? They must surely do so given the direction of travel at Arsenal. City do retain the cheat code that is Erling Haaland.

There are parallels between City and Liverpool, who want their new manager, Andoni Iraola, to have a similar impact in his first season that Arne Slot managed in 2024-25. Slot took Klopp’s team and glided to the title. Maybe consistency in the dugout is not everything?

On the other hand, Slot was given only one new player – Federico Chiesa – who barely played that season and he essentially stuck with what had made the Klopp collective so successful. It was evolution not revolution. When he tried the latter last season, Slot found that his tenure unravelled, although his rotten luck with injuries must be acknowledged. There was also the death of Diogo Jota.

Liverpool have moved on Andy Robertson, Ibrahima Konaté and, most crucially, Mohamed Salah, even if he was a shadow of his former self last season. Salah has not yet been replaced; it would be impossible to replace the prime-years version of him and Iraola, who has a number of injury concerns, has it all to do.

Coaxing more from Florian Wirtz and Alexander Isak is fundamental. Iraola’s style has the capacity to hold Anfield in thrall; the aggression, the front-foot slickness, the boldness to go one-versus-one all over the pitch. How quickly can he impose it?

Chelsea will be interesting under Xabi Alonso, who has been allowed to add players to fit into the 3-4-2-1 he used to such stunning effect at Bayer Leverkusen. Alonso has also been permitted to break from the club’s youth-first signing model and bring in much-needed experience.

Morgan Rogers, alongside Cole Palmer and behind João Pedro, with Moisés Caicedo and maybe Reece James in the deep midfield roles, has a very nice feel to it. There is talent in central defence. The lack of European football will be a temporary blessing.

Ask any chief executive what supporters want at the start of a season and the answer is invariably the same: be better than last season. Which will not be a problem for Chelsea after the implosion to limp home in 10th. Or Spurs, who finished 17th for the second campaign in a row and narrowly avoided relegation. Roberto De Zerbi, who was appointed as the manager with seven games to go, kept them up and in the first summer since the end of Daniel Levy’s near 25-year as chair, the new hierarchy have been determined to act decisively. Their heavy spend on Premier League-proven players has allowed the fanbase to dream.

De Zerbi is a man to generate buy-in. In him they trust. Ditto a midfield that will feature Sandro Tonali and Mateus Fernandes. With Conor Gallagher or James Maddison expected to fill the No 10 role, Spurs look to have a proper unit to hold things together. They will also benefit from no European football.

What about United, for whom everything suddenly came together after the appointment of Michael Carrick in January, initially for an interim spell? His record meant the club had to give him the job on a permanent basis – he finished the season with 12 wins and three draws from 17 league matches. It was 2.3 points per game. Transpose that over a 38-match campaign and you get 87 points. Arsenal won the title with 85. Are United dark horses for glory?

Concerns remain. Carrick was largely untroubled by injuries and when United have their best XI on the field they are a match for anybody. When they miss a few, as they normally did under Ruben Amorim, they can flatline. United were always going to have to add a good number of signings this summer, particularly as they prepare to go from a Europe-free season to a return to the Champions League. They have not yet done enough; the final week-and-a-half of the transfer window could be crucial. As Mike Tyson almost said, everybody has a plan until they are punched in the face by the Champions League.

Are Villa really about to take another step forward after the highs of last season when they finished fourth and won the Europa League? It feels unlikely given the departures, headlined by those of Rogers, Youri Tielemans and Lucas Digne, with Konsa primed to go, too. Strangely, there is a whiff of transition about them. It is possible to find reasons to fret about every team. Apart from Arsenal.

items.titleZh: 英超回归，阿森纳趁对手动荡觅良机
items.summaryZh: 新帅众多，争冠对手动荡，阿森纳渴望再夺一冠；阿尔特塔强调球队不是卫冕而是进攻。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔想把自己的话讲得完全到位。在他看来，阿森纳并非要卫冕英超冠军，而是要向另一个冠军发起冲击。
还记得几年前主教练带到俱乐部训练场的那条名叫“赢”的狗吗？她现在必须被叫做“已赢”。但正是阿尔特塔对语义的计较，凸显了他为何带着如此充沛的精力和乐观进入新赛季。
不要跟他谈论阿森纳的稳定。他更喜欢“持续性”以及更有冲击力的词，比如“雄心”。整体主题很明确。当阿尔特塔审视英格兰顶级联赛的格局时，他看到了自己俱乐部的安定环境和别处的变动。
就所谓的“六大豪门”而言——据德勤排名，他们是最富有的俱乐部——曼城、利物浦和切尔西都换了新帅；热刺几乎算新帅，曼联的主帅也相对较新。这是一个英超史上变动最大的夏天，有九家俱乐部迎来了新掌门。在那些仍有望挑战冠军的球队中，只有阿斯顿维拉的乌奈·埃梅里执教已久。
相当突然地，阿尔特塔发现自己成了联赛中执教时间最长的主帅；他于2019年12月在阿森纳接替埃梅里。埃梅里位列第二，已在维拉执教三年零九个月，而只有另一位主帅——利兹联的丹尼尔·法尔克——在俱乐部待了超过三年。
当阿尔特塔接手阿森纳时，佩普·瓜迪奥拉在传奇曼城生涯中已夺得两冠，尤尔根·克洛普在利物浦赢得欧冠，并且那个赛季正在通向联赛冠军的路上，何塞·穆里尼奥则刚刚加盟热刺。
阿尔特塔已经将他们一一送走，其中瓜迪奥拉在上赛季末离开曼城，是即将到来的赛季格局中最大的一次变动。
阿尔特塔现在是巨无霸，是唯一一位现任的英超冠军教练。阿森纳周五晚上将在主场迎战考文垂开启新赛季，很难忽视他们流露出的自信。几乎所有竞争对手都处于过渡期，不确定性削弱了期待，在缺乏实际依据时难以预测，而阿森纳因根基稳固而安心。他们嗅到了机会，另一个冠军，一个王朝的建立。那是终极目标。
还有更多。即上赛季最后几周，一切天平向他们倾斜。曼城付出了巨大努力，从三月中旬追回九分差距——当时他们少赛一场。但在随后的五场对决中，曼城先绷不住了，在埃弗顿踢平。大多数人都知道这对阿森纳来说多么煎熬，尤其是阿尔特塔。当阿森纳最后一次在酋长球场踢球——赛季倒数第二轮对阵伯恩利——球场焦虑弥漫。他们艰难地1-0拿下。
随后曼城在伯恩茅斯打平，一切都结束了；阿森纳22年的等待，沉重的负担。无法低估那种解放感。没人能质疑这支球队的勇气。没人会再嘲讽“又是第二，噢来噢来”。很明显，阿尔特塔和他的球员们会汲取这种力量，也许他们会踢出更开放的足球。上次在关键时刻，害怕功亏一篑束缚了他们的发挥。
阿森纳在幕后做出了调整，寻求微小提升，最明显的是医疗部门，首席队医扎法尔·伊克巴尔于六月初双方协议离任。阿纳尔多·阿布兰特斯从阿斯顿维拉来顶替。如果球员们能在更长时间内保持健康，阿森纳相信他们能保持领先。他们通过引援加深本已强大的阵容来保护自己。布鲁诺·吉马良斯是最引人注目的新援，埃兹里·孔萨也即将加盟。
阿森纳对曼城仍然像是头号对决。上赛季瓜迪奥拉对付阿尔特塔很有一套，三场交锋两胜一平。在卡拉宝杯决赛中，曼城2-0获胜，表现远胜对手。但那是在瓜迪奥拉麾下，而且有罗德里和伯纳多·席尔瓦。如果瓜迪奥拉的离开是曼城最大的打击，那么两位中场核心分别转会巴萨和皇马也不遑多让。
曼城对新主帅恩佐·马雷斯卡的信心，源于他们看到他在教练组工作时的情况；他是2022-23赛季三冠王时期的瓜迪奥拉助手。此前，他带领U23队在2020-21赛季赢得英超二级联赛冠军。
这是一个经过深思熟虑的任命；是优秀俱乐部会做出的决定。但同时也并非让人兴奋的任命。简单说，马雷斯卡要填补巨大的空缺。埃利奥特·安德森也是如此，这位令人印象深刻的年轻中场是曼城押上重注的人。在损失了多名球员后，曼城能变得更好吗？考虑到阿森纳的上升势头，他们当然必须如此。曼城确实还拥有埃尔林·哈兰德这个作弊器。
曼城和利物浦有相似之处，利物浦希望新帅安多尼·伊劳拉在处子赛季能发挥出阿尔内·斯洛特在2024-25赛季那样的作用。斯洛特接手克洛普的球队，轻松夺得冠军。也许教练席的稳定性并非一切？
另一方面，斯洛特只得到了一名新援——费德里科·基耶萨——他那个赛季几乎没有上场，斯洛特基本上沿用了克洛普集体成功的模式。这是进化而非革命。上赛季当他试图革命时，他发现自己的任期瓦解了，尽管他伤病缠身的坏运气也必须承认。还有迪奥戈·若塔的离世。

利物浦已经送走了安迪·罗伯逊、易卜拉希马·科纳特，最重要的是，穆罕默德·萨拉赫，尽管他上赛季已经风采不再。萨拉赫还没有替代者；要想替代巅峰期的他是不可能的，而伊劳拉面临诸多伤病问题，任重道远。
从弗洛里安·维尔茨和亚历山大·伊萨克身上再挖掘更多潜力是根本。伊劳拉的风格有能力让安菲尔德为之着迷；侵略性、前场的流畅度、全场一对一对抗的胆量。他能多快将这种风格灌输给球队？
哈维·阿隆索执教下的切尔西将会很有趣，他被允许引进适合他在勒沃库森取得惊人效果的3-4-2-1阵型的球员。阿隆索还被允许打破俱乐部以年轻球员为先的引援模式，引入急需的经验。
摩根·罗杰斯与科尔·帕尔默搭档，若昂·佩德罗突前，莫伊塞斯·凯塞多和可能的里斯·詹姆斯担任拖后中场，这样的组合感觉相当不错。中卫位置有天赋。没有欧战将是一个暂时的福音。
问任何一位首席执行官，球迷在赛季开始时想要什么，答案总是一样：比上赛季更好。对于上赛季崩溃最终只排第10的切尔西来说，这不是问题。或者对连续两个赛季排名第17、勉强保级的热刺来说，也是如此。罗伯托·德泽尔比在赛季还剩下7轮时被任命为主帅，他帮助球队成功保级。在丹尼尔·列维将近25年主席任期结束后的第一个夏天，新管理层决意果断行动。他们在有英超经验的球员身上豪掷千金，让球迷得以梦想。
德泽尔比是那种能赢得支持的人。他们信任他。中场也将以桑德罗·托纳利和马特乌斯·费尔南德斯为特色。预计康纳·加拉格尔或詹姆斯·麦迪逊将出任10号位，热刺看起来有合适的配置来稳住局面。他们还将受益于没有欧战。
曼联呢？在1月份任命迈克尔·卡里克执教（最初是临时）后，一切突然变得顺畅。他的战绩让俱乐部不得不给他转正——他带队的17场联赛取得12胜3平。场均2.3分。按38场比赛折算，就是87分。阿森纳以85分夺冠。曼联会是夺冠的黑马吗？
担忧依然存在。卡里克基本没有受到伤病困扰，当曼联派上他们最好的11人时，他们能对抗任何人。但若缺了几人，就像鲁本·阿莫林执教时常发生的那样，他们可能一蹶不振。曼联今年夏天注定要引进不少新援，尤其是他们准备从无欧战的赛季回归欧冠。他们做得还不够；转会窗最后一周半可能至关重要。正如迈克·泰森几乎说过的那样，人人都有计划，直到被欧冠一拳击中面部。
经历了上赛季排名第四并赢得欧联杯的高峰后，维拉真的准备再进一步吗？鉴于球员流失，包括罗杰斯、尤里·蒂勒曼斯和卢卡斯·迪涅，孔萨也准备离开，这似乎不太可能。奇怪的是，他们身上有几分过渡的气息。你有可能找到理由为每支球队担忧。除了阿森纳。

items.titleEn: Arteta demands ‘desire and ambition’ for title defence and says Lewis-Skelly will stay
items.summaryEn: ‘We start from scratch,’ says Arsenal managerChampions begin defence against Coventry on FridayMikel Arteta has called on Arsenal to prove they have the desire to defend their Premier League title on the eve of the new season. He also reiterated that Myles Lewis-Skelly will not be leaving in this transfer window.Arsenal face Coventry in their opening match on Friday night as they attempt to retain the championship for the first time since the 1930s. Arsenal have won 17 of their past 18 matches against promoted teams and have not been beaten at the Emirates Stadium by one since November 2010 – a run of 45 matches. Continue reading...
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has called on Arsenal to prove they have the desire to defend their Premier League title on the eve of the new season. He also reiterated that Myles Lewis-Skelly will not be leaving in this transfer window.

Arsenal face Coventry in their opening match on Friday night as they attempt to retain the championship for the first time since the 1930s. Arsenal have won 17 of their past 18 matches against promoted teams and have not been beaten at the Emirates Stadium by one since November 2010 – a run of 45 matches.

While Arsenal are heavy favourites to start with a comfortable victory, especially after their impressive win over Manchester City in the Community Shield on Sunday, Arteta believes they must adapt to a different challenge this time.

“We need to take this organically because it’s going to be a long marathon,” he said. “What we need to show is that desire and ambition to be better than we were last season, a month ago, or a week ago when we played Man City. We have the ability to improve, to evolve, and that’s what I sense and I feel around the club and especially around the players.”

Asked whether Arsenal begin the season with a target on their backs, he said: “Today, no, because we start from scratch and we’re going to have to prove we have the level to go back to that position again.
“But that happened in the last three seasons – at some point we were first, at some point we were chasing it, and you never know what’s better.
“You give me the choice, I want to be first, I want to be hunted, and I want to be in control of our future, rather than depending on somebody else.”

It is understood Myles Lewis-Skelly was offered to Manchester United and Chelsea as Arsenal attempt to raise funds after the £75m purchase of Bruno Guimarães from Newcastle. The 19-year-old academy graduate was outstanding in midfield against City in Cardiff, having also started in that position in the Champions League final last season against Paris Saint-Germain, and Arteta is “100%” confident he will remain at Arsenal.

“The players that have been raised in our system, and they feel that love and that connection with the club, bring something else, there’s no question about that,” he said. “We need to look after them in a really special way because they bring value that is very difficult to find. That’s why, when we can, we want to protect those assets as much as possible, develop them and make them extremely important for the club.”
Arteta said Martín Zubimendi remains an integral part of his squad and he expects the midfielder to remain despite reported interest from Real Madrid.

Zubimendi was outstanding for most of last season before losing his place to Lewis-Skelly, but Arteta said he has reassured the Spain international that he still has a big role to play at the club “I had various conversations with him. First of all, for him to understand my decisions, he knew perfectly where they were coming from and he’s an extremely honest and straight guy. He’s so demanding of himself that sometimes it can be too much.
“But he knows that and he knew that we were going to add and increase the quality of the squad. Because it has to happen in every position and we cannot not do what we did.

“When he got to the last stage of his season, he already played 55 games. We cannot have that again at this level. He recognises that. Now it’s going to be: ‘OK, how I’m going to now raise the level to be able to do what I did last year. But for 11 months.’”

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔要求球队展现‘渴望与雄心’以卫冕冠军，并表示刘易斯-斯凯利将留队
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳主帅称将从零开始，周五对阵考文垂开启卫冕征程。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔呼吁阿森纳在新赛季前夕证明他们有卫冕英超冠军的渴望。他还重申，迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利不会在本次转会窗口离队。
阿森纳将在周五晚上的揭幕战中迎战考文垂，试图自1930年代以来首次成功卫冕冠军。阿森纳在过去18场对阵升班马的比赛中赢了17场，并且自2010年11月以来在酋长球场从未输给过升班马——这一纪录延续了45场比赛。
尽管阿森纳以轻松获胜开局的热门身份备受青睐，尤其是在周日社区盾杯中令人印象深刻地战胜曼城之后，阿尔特塔认为他们这次必须适应不同的挑战。
“我们需要自然而然地对待这个问题，因为这将是一场漫长的马拉松，”他说。“我们需要展示的是渴望和雄心，要比上赛季、一个月前或一周前对阵曼城时更好。我们有能力改进、进化，这是我在俱乐部尤其是球员身上感受到的。”
当被问及阿森纳是否以背负靶子的身份开始赛季时，他说：“今天不是，因为我们从零开始，我们必须证明自己有能力再次回到那个位置。”
“但在过去三个赛季中，这种情况发生过——有时我们领先，有时我们在追赶，你永远不知道哪种情况更好。”
“如果让我选择，我想成为第一，我想被追逐，我想掌控自己的未来，而不是依赖别人。”
据了解，阿森纳为了在从纽卡斯尔以7500万英镑签下布鲁诺·吉马良斯后筹集资金，曾向曼联和切尔西推荐了迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利。这位19岁的青训毕业生在加的夫对阵曼城的比赛中表现出色，他在中场位置首发，上赛季欧冠决赛对阵巴黎圣日耳曼时也曾担任该位置，阿尔特塔“百分之百”确信他会留在阿森纳。
“在我们体系中成长起来的球员，他们感受到对俱乐部的爱和联系，会带来其他东西，这是毫无疑问的，”他说。“我们需要以特殊的方式照顾他们，因为他们带来了难以找到的价值。因此，只要可能，我们就想尽可能保护这些资产，培养他们，让他们对俱乐部变得极其重要。”
阿尔特塔表示，马丁·苏比门迪仍然是球队不可或缺的一部分，尽管有报道称皇家马德里对他感兴趣，但他预计这位中场球员会留下。
